items.title: Spotify DJ gets new voices, and the ability to stop yammering
items.excerpt: Spotify's AI DJ adds eight more English voices in various accents and two Spanish voices, plus an option to turn off the commentary entirely.

items.title: VSL introduce Vienna Performer
items.excerpt: Vienna Symphonic Library's Vienna Performer is an AI-powered plugin that takes a user's MIDI part and renders it with modelled phrasing, bowing, breath, vibrato and timing; models were trained only on VSL's own Synchron Stage recordings and there is no generative note output.

items.title: NeuTone Launches NeuSynth, an AI Stem Generator That Creates New Instrument Layers from 60 Seconds of Audio in Your DAW
items.excerpt: Korean AI audio startup NeuTone announced NeuSynth, an in-DAW plugin that analyses about 60 seconds of a track and generates new instrument stem layers that fit it.

items.title: Logic Pro 13 gets touch right, but stumbles on "intelligent assistant"
items.excerpt: CDM's hands-on with the shipping Logic Pro 13 finds the touch features solid but the new AI 'intelligent assistant' stumbling in real production tasks.

items.title: One of Logic Pro 13's biggest new features can only be had on subscription: is that fair, and should you care?
items.excerpt: Now that Logic Pro 13 has rolled out, it turns out the AI-powered intelligent assistant is only in the subscription Creator Studio version, not the one-time-purchase DAW.

history_match.title: Apple's $50 Intelligence Usage Packs extend access to some AI features

items.title: Ex-bandmates Dr Dre and Ice Cube clash over the use of AI
items.excerpt: On the first episode of Ice Cube's new podcast, Dr Dre argued producers must adopt AI or be left behind, while Ice Cube pushed back.

items.title: AI-music labelling 'can't be just the platforms' says RIAA boss
items.excerpt: RIAA chief Mitch Glazier told The Verge's Decoder that labelling AI music can't fall only on DSPs, outlining the industry's view on disclosure and voice rights.

items.title: Backlash Already Rumbles Against Spotify's Upcoming Remix Tool
items.excerpt: Spotify's upcoming AI cover/remix tool is drawing online criticism over fairness to artists and the ethics of AI training before it even launches.

history_match.title: Spotify Reportedly Set to Debut AI Cover & Remix Tool in Early '27

items.title: Human Enough? How AI Detector Scores Put Indie Artists at Risk
items.excerpt: Data piece on how platforms treat AI-detector percentage scores as verdicts, and how indie artists get penalised by false positives.

history_match.title: More AI Detector False Positives Emerge In Rapid Succession: Do Indie Musicians Have a Serious Problem Here?

items.title: Albanese's love affair with music is on the rocks over AI. Can he write a different tune?
items.excerpt: Opinion: Australia's PM is trying to untangle AI training and copyright as musicians push back against a text-and-data-mining exception.

items.title: 존박·곽진언 '맥도날드 주문 랩', 해외 음원 플랫폼에 무단 등록…작사·작곡자도 제3자
items.excerpt: John Park and Kwak Jin-eon's viral 'McDonald's order rap' was uploaded to Spotify and YouTube Music by an unknown act with third-party credits, with an added rap in a John Park-like voice raising suspicion of generative-AI voice cloning.

items.title: AI로 선율 입힌 셰익스피어詩…용호성 前차관, 첫 정규앨범 발표
items.excerpt: Former culture vice-minister Yong Ho-seong, under the name 'Dr. Dragon', released a first full album setting Shakespeare's poems to AI-generated melodies.

items.title: 이터니티, AI와 음악의 만남…'Crepuscule Syndrome'으로 글로벌 협업
items.excerpt: Pulse9's AI virtual idol group IITERNITI releases English single 'Crepuscule Syndrome' on 11 November, co-produced with Italian team KIDOKORO, with an MV the same day.

items.title: AI Slop FM radio experiment puts machines on trial, one dodgy tune at a time
items.excerpt: A Welsh music fan's 'AI Slop FM' radio show pits AI-generated songs against human tracks and lets listeners judge them.

items.title: Nick Cave says AI song generators are "indicators of this nascent technology's demonic potential"
items.excerpt: In a new Red Hand Files post Nick Cave attacks AI song generators as mocking creation itself.

items.title: MyPart Launches AI Agents for Visual Music Matching and Song Search, and Adaptive Music Gaming with Epidemic Sound
items.excerpt: Music-tech firm MyPart launched AI agents that match music to visuals and search songs by description, plus adaptive in-game music with Epidemic Sound.

items.title: Japan Launches Global IP.AI Initiative to Protect Anime, Manga, and Music Creators From Unauthorized AI Use
items.excerpt: A new Japan IP.AI Co-Creation body aims to protect anime, manga and music rights holders from unauthorised generative-AI training and use.

items.title: Music Inpainting With Similarity-Guided Latent Diffusion
items.excerpt: New paper proposes a latent-diffusion music inpainting method guided by similarity to surrounding context, for filling or replacing gaps in audio.

items.title: Latent Terrain: Adapting Neural Audio Autoencoders as Design Materials in NIME
items.excerpt: Paper on turning neural audio autoencoder latent spaces into playable 'terrains' for new musical instrument design.

history_match.title: Smorph: playable diffusion-based sound morphing for musical sound design

items.title: 추천 빼고 수익 제한…저질 AI 콘텐츠 차단 나선 플랫폼
items.excerpt: Spotify, YouTube, Naver and other platforms are filtering low-quality generative-AI content out of search and recommendations and restricting its monetisation.

items.title: 수노, 하루 하나 작곡 주제 제공…노래를 달력에 모은다
